newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission condemns Taleban stance on women.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission condemns Taleban stance on women.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it deplored what it called a deprivation of the fundamental rights of women by Afghanistan's purist Islamic Taleban.
In a statement, the Commission said rules imposed on women by the Taleban contravened the United Nations Charter and world conventions on human rights.
"The international community cannot stand idle while a policy based in particular on massive gender discrimination is perpetrated by the Talebans," it said.
It called on governments and the international community to pressure the Taleban to respect all human and particularly women's rights.
The movement, founded by religious students, captured the Afghan capital Kabul on September 27.
It has told women they should stay at home, no longer work and be completely veiled in public. Schools are also closed to girls.
Humanitarian Aid Commissioner Emma Bonino has already spoken out against the Taleban's treatment of women on several occasions.
